correctness.rationale: The patch replaces the two hard-coded install.sh/test.sh checks with an explicit scripts array covering all five requested glob patterns (*.sh, scripts/*.sh, scripts/checks/*.sh, scripts/setup/*.sh, scripts/lib/*.sh), enables nullglob during expansion, and loops with bash -n plus independent pass()/fail() per file—matching the parser-only, explicit-glob, per-file reporting contract. One-point deduction for redirecting bash -n stderr to /dev/null (hides failure diagnostics) and because bundle evidence cannot confirm whether expanded coverage revealed latent syntax errors elsewhere requiring fixes in the same diff.

quality.rationale: Core check change is minimal, readable, and repo-consistent: nullglob with an explicit glob list and a straightforward for-loop over pass()/fail() helpers. Deductions for stderr suppression on bash -n failures, absence of inline comments documenting glob rationale or empty-set handling, and diff noise from five additional .context state/session files beyond the required check script.

process.rationale: Handshake discipline is partially evident: latest_summary, handoff, _active task claim, and coordination lock document decisions and next steps. However the diff violates the task scope constraint (PR should remain scoped to the check and required doc-sync) by touching forbidden .context/state and .context/sessions paths, and no documented no-change doc-sync decision appears in bundle artifacts.

reliability.rationale: Objective evidence confirms test wiring (6/6) and bash_n_check_script pass. Handoff and latest_summary consistently claim bash -n on the changed script, full bash test.sh pass, and a deliberate negative smoke via temporary breakage of scripts/verify-env.sh with restoration—stronger than bundles with no verification notes. One-point deduction because full_test_sh was skipped in bundle-only grading and no raw command transcripts are present to independently corroborate the negative-smoke cycle.

uncertainty_notes: full_test_sh was skipped in bundle-only grading; bash test.sh pass/fail/restore and negative-smoke outcomes are self-reported in session/handoff artifacts without raw command output.
Cannot confirm from bundle alone whether expanded coverage would have revealed latent syntax errors elsewhere requiring fixes in the same diff.
